title: Product Data Analyst
Product Data Analyst
description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants on a tap, send money to friends, track their spending, and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people actually use it. As the tribe scales, so does the need for sharp, reliable insight into how people actually use what we build.

We're looking for a Product Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer — working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and measure what matters.

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence product decisions — this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance for SumUp Consumer using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation, and behavioural analytics to identify opportunities and drive improvements
  • Support Product Managers in understanding customer journeys, engagement, conversion, and retention — helping to shape product strategy and priorities
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Define, monitor, and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs — covering activation, engagement, and retention — and evaluate the impact of product changes for stakeholders
  • Design, execute, and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, helping to embed a culture of experimentation across the Consumer tribe
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, and growth opportunities before they're asked for
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic, and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable, and trusted
  • Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation and product measurement
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and Data teams to ground decisions in robust analysis and customer insight

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing, and validating data in a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)
  • You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and segmentation
  • You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them
  • You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use
  • You can translate ambiguous business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike
  • You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, and customer understanding
  • You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work in a truly global, multicultural team from our open, vibrant Cologne office, located in the heart of the city. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🚗 Commute made easy: subsidised mobility options like discounted transport tickets or bike leasing

💪 Stay active: access to fitness via Urban Sports Club, mostly covered by SumUp

💰 Financial health: a corporate pension scheme with SumUp contributing an extra 20% on top of your contribution

🎁 Employee perks: get discounts across products and services via our Corporate Benefits platform

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Business Analyst
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. 

The Role:

Are you a passionate problem-solver with a knack for deciphering financial and commercial data to uncover real business impact? Driven by the desire to shape growth strategies through actionable insights? If so, we invite you to join us as a Business Analyst.

At Paddle, we are building an analytical culture that empowers every team member to harness data for smarter decision-making. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in driving customer profitability, improving gross margins, and optimizing our cost structures. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will turn complex financial data into insights that directly influence revenue growth, pricing strategies, and operational efficiency.

What you'll do:

  • Revenue & Pricing Analysis: Evaluate pricing initiatives and commercial strategies, modeling scenarios to help optimize revenue generation and measure business impact.

  • Profitability & Cost Optimization: Analyze key drivers of customer profitability, margins, and cost of sales to highlight opportunities for efficiency, cost reduction, and growth.

  • Core Data Analytics: Perform in-depth analytical work to uncover trends, translating complex datasets into clear, practical recommendations—not just buzzwords.

  • Data Alignment & Infrastructure: Partner with Data Engineering and analytics teams to define requirements and ensure efficient data models are built for commercial and financial reporting.

  • Dashboards & Reporting: Build, maintain, and enhance BI dashboards and visualisations to ensure critical metrics remain visible, accurate, and actionable across teams.

  • Cross-Functional Execution: Work alongside stakeholders across Finance, Product, Go-To-Market, and Operations to translate analytical insights into action and track their long-term impact.

  • Analytics Culture & Process: Advocate for data-informed decision-making across the business, helping refine analytical processes and improving data accuracy over time.

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • An Analytical Professional: Proven track record in Data or Business Analysis, ideally within a tech or SaaS environment. Experience in finance, pricing, margin analysis, or payments is a plus.

  • Technically Proficient: Skilled in SQL, Google Sheets, and BI/visualisation platforms (e.g., Omni, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI).

  • A Creative Problem-Solver: Possess an inventive, resourceful approach to tackling ambiguous data challenges, embracing tough problems head-on rather than backing down.

  • A Critical Thinker: Able to break down complex commercial models and translate detailed data into clear, high-impact recommendations.

  • An Effective Communicator: Skilled at presenting insights clearly to stakeholders across functions and building strong collaborative relationships.

  • Detail-Oriented & Resilient: Thorough with data accuracy, precise in your calculations, and excited about navigating a dynamic environment with complex challenges.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Our Values

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
description:
As a Data Analyst (m/f/d) focussing in the land domain for unmanned ground vehicles, you will play a leading role within the Cloud & Data Team, owning the evaluation, interpretation, and continuous improvement of analytics for large-scale telemetry and system data. You will shape how data is analyzed across products and platforms, enabling data-driven decisions in R&D, production, testing, and customer support. You will work with a highly skilled team and collaborate closely with stakeholders across the globe. In this role, you will combine advanced analytical skills, algorithm development, and technical leadership to build robust, automated evaluation methods for complex technical systems.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead tool-based analysis of telemetry and system data across R&D, production, testing, and customer support

  • Own and evolve the data analysis toolchain, ensuring scalability, reliability, and reproducibility

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated data evaluation and testing pipelines

  • Drive the design and use of database solutions for large-scale telemetry data

  • Evaluate, prototype, and deploy advanced analytics and AI-based methods, including anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, and online monitoring of subsystems

  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers to integrate analytics into production systems

  • Communicate insights and analytical results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Act as a technical mentor and analytical authority within the team



What you bring to the team:

Data Analysis & Algorithms

  • Strong hands-on experience using python for data analysis and algorithm development

  • Solid understanding of statistics, hypothesis testing, and data validation techniques

  • Experience designing custom evaluation algorithms for complex or high-frequency data

  • Strong experience with time-series analysis and telemetry data

 

Data & Databases

  • Experience working with timeseries, structured, unstructured and analytical databases

  • Good understanding of efficient data storage, retrieval, and optimization strategies

  • Experience collaborating on data models and analytical interfaces

 

Advanced Analytics

  • Experience evaluating or implementing machine learning or AI-based methods (e.g. anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, trend analysis)

  • Understanding of model validation, robustness, and monitoring in production contexts


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Senior Data Analyst  (Marketing Analytics)
description:
What is the job?

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next.

This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions.

Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.

  • Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.

  • Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.

  • Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.

  • Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.

  • Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.

  • Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.

What do you need?

  • Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.

  • Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.

  • A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.

  • Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.

  • Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation: £60K – £70K

title: Data Analyst, Accounting Data and Systems
description:
About the Team

It’s an exciting time to join our rapidly growing Accounting team with ample development opportunities. We're growing the Revenue Data team with Engineering and Accounting Data openings to drive our automation and systems infrastructure and while keeping pace within one of the fastest growing marketplace companies.

 

About the Role

The Senior Engineer for Accounting Infrastructure and Systems designs, builds, and maintains the scalable backend services, data pipelines, and integrations that power DoorDash's accounting, reconciliation, and financial reporting workflows. Working closely with Finance, Accounting, and fellow engineers, this role translates complex financial and regulatory requirements into reliable, automated systems that ensure accuracy, auditability, and compliance at scale. The ideal candidate brings strong distributed-systems and data engineering expertise along with a solid understanding of financial processes, and takes technical ownership of critical projects while mentoring junior engineers and helping shape the team's architecture and best practices.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Take technical ownership of critical accounting infrastructure projects — designing and building the backend services, data pipelines, and integrations that power DoorDash's financial reporting, reconciliation, and close workflows at scale.

  • Partner directly with Finance and Accounting stakeholders to translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into reliable, auditable, and automated systems.

  • Shape the team's architecture and engineering best practices, mentoring junior engineers and raising the technical bar across the organization.

  • Drive measurable improvements in data accuracy, pipeline reliability, and system performance in a high-impact, compliance-critical environment.

We're excited about you because…

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software or data engineering, with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex backend or data infrastructure projects.

  • You have deep expertise in distributed systems and data engineering, with hands-on experience in tools like Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, or similar modern data stack technologies.

  • You can navigate the intersection of engineering and finance — understanding concepts like revenue recognition, reconciliation, and auditability well enough to build systems that meet those requirements.

  • You have a collaborative, low-ego approach and can effectively partner with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across Finance, Accounting, and Engineering.

  • Familiarity with SOX controls, data quality frameworks, or financial systems (e.g., NetSuite) is a strong plus.

Why Join Us?

At DoorDash, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a massive marketplace that’s constantly evolving. By joining our London-based team on a Deliveroo contract, you get the unique advantage of working within a vibrant local business environment while directly blueprinting global-scale processes for the broader DoorDash Inc. group.

We’re problem solvers, community builders, and innovators, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Make a visible impact every day: Your work directly improves experiences for merchants, consumers, partners, and dashers/riders worldwide by building clean, frictionless operational workflows.

  • 🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment: Work close to the market with autonomy, pace, and real responsibility.

  • 🧠 Build a career, not just a role: Stretch yourself, develop new skills, and grow as the global business evolves.

  • 🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture: Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

DoorDash brings together brands and teams with massive reach, scale, and ambition. In this role, you will collaborate directly with teammates, systems, and leaders across our entire global footprint, including Deliveroo, Wolt, and DoorDash US. Together, we are unlocking new possibilities and driving global impact as one unified team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
